request.text: Before I head out to refill the bird feeder, check tomorrow morning's weather, then set a 7:00 a.m. reminder to water the tomato seedlings even if rain is forecast.

responsibilities.outcome: Look up and report the weather forecast for tomorrow morning before the reminder is created.
Create a reminder for 7:00 a.m. tomorrow to water the tomato seedlings, regardless of whether rain is forecast.

semantic_facts: The weather lookup and reminder creation remain separate Responsibilities, with r1 preceding r2.
The reminder is unconditional and must still be created if the forecast includes rain.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims that it refilled the bird feeder or watered the seedlings.
The reminder is omitted or made conditional on a dry forecast.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: An explicit sequence of independent executable Responsibilities is collapsed into one task.
A contextual forecast changes an unconditional reminder into a conditional or omitted effect.
